user.title: Your stoves
user.description: Which stoves would you like to connect locally? One gateway connects all selected stoves.

address.title: Stove address
address.description:
**{stove_name}** · Stove {position} of {total}

Find the IP address in your router’s device list. Reserve it there for this stove.

network.title: Almost there
network.description:
Redirect your stoves' vendor hostnames, for example remote.mcz.it, to the Home Assistant LAN IP in your router or DNS service. Keep any existing redirect.

Next, choose **Local Wi-Fi** in Agua IOT. It is accepted only after every stove returns a live reading.

The gateway does not change your router or turn on a stove.

EEPROM protection is enabled automatically: at most 15 writes per hour and 50 per day. Choose **Configure → Write protection per stove** to lower the limits or block changes entirely.

safety.title: Write protection
safety.description:
**{stove_name}**

Permanently stored settings, such as schedules or setpoints, use EEPROM memory. Frequent writes can wear it out. Reading and RAM controls remain available.

Recommended: at most 15 writes in 60 minutes and 50 in 24 hours. Counts survive restarts.
